why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Cambrian site Go to the Cambrian homepage and read how it describes its onchain and offchain financial data API.
2 Step 2 : Open the pricing page Press Get API Access, which leads to the pricing page , to see how access to the API is offered.
3 Step 3 : Check account sign-in The privacy policy describes account registration and sign-in through a third-party identity provider.
4 Step 4 : Try the API On the homepage, Start querying and Try the API both lead to the same pricing page as Get API Access.
5 Step 5 : Read the comparison page Open the page that the homepage labels "Read more & compare".
